# ParallaxController

> Mouse-position tilt effect — subtle rotateX/rotateY transform relative to element center. Optional glare overlay and gyroscope support.

## Constructor

```ts
new ParallaxController(host: HTMLElement, options?: ParallaxOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `maxTilt` | `number` | no | Maximum tilt angle in degrees (default 15) |
| `perspective` | `number` | no | Perspective in px (default 1000) |
| `speed` | `number` | no | Transition speed when entering/leaving in ms (default 300) |
| `scale` | `number` | no | Scale factor on hover (default 1.05) |
| `glare` | `boolean` | no | Enable glare/shine effect via CSS gradient (default false) |
| `glareOpacity` | `number` | no | Max glare opacity 0-1 (default 0.35) |
| `gyroscope` | `boolean` | no | Enable gyroscope on mobile (default false) |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Disable the controller |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:parallax-move` | `{ tiltX, tiltY, percentX, percentY }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |
| `reset()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { ParallaxController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new ParallaxController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
